jobs.description:
About the Team
OpenAI’s Governance team helps shape how the company responsibly develops and deploys increasingly capable AI. We bring together technical evidence, policy, and operational perspectives to help the company address emerging risks, resolve difficult questions, and make well-supported decisions.
Our work includes shaping and improving governance practices, supporting effective oversight, developing clear assessments and recommendations, and ensuring that decisions lead to action. We work closely with research, safety, security, legal, and product teams to identify gaps, reconcile different views, and improve our approach as capabilities and circumstances change.
About the Role
We are looking for a curious, high-agency Research Program Manager who can reason from first principles, make sense of incomplete or conflicting information, and move difficult work forward. You will help shape the substance of governance reviews, connect ideas and evidence across teams, and develop recommendations that are both well-founded and practical.
The work requires someone who can use established approaches where they fit, recognize when circumstances call for a different approach, and update their thinking as new evidence emerges. You should bring sound judgment, a willingness to experiment and learn, and the program-management discipline to turn good analysis into action.
Depending on your experience and the team’s needs, your work may focus on safety advisory and board-level oversight, deployment governance, or standards and strategic partner commitments.
In this role, you will:
• Bring together technical, policy, and operational inputs to develop coherent assessments, recommendations, and decision materials for governance bodies and senior leaders.

• Work through emerging or ambiguous questions, test assumptions, identify gaps or conflicting evidence, and help determine what additional analysis or decisions are needed.

• Engage critically with research, evaluations, safeguards, and risk assessments, working with the relevant experts to understand what the evidence supports and where uncertainty remains.

• Partner with governance-body chairs, technical leaders, and other stakeholders to shape substantive reviews, frame the questions that matter, and communicate conclusions clearly.

• Translate feedback, recommendations, and decisions into concrete work with accountable owners, milestones, dependencies, and clear criteria for completion.

• Drive that work forward across teams, resolve blockers, surface difficult tradeoffs, and escalate disagreements or resource gaps when needed.

• Help teams understand which governance processes apply, integrate reviews into research and deployment plans, and identify changes that require further consideration.

• Maintain clear records of decisions, rationale, conditions, commitments, exceptions, and unresolved questions.

• Help improve governance practices, standards, and guidance as capabilities, evidence, and circumstances evolve.

• Build and refine practical tools, operating cadences, and sources of truth that improve the quality and pace of the work.

• Develop trusted relationships across Research, Safety Systems, Preparedness, Security, Legal, Product, leadership, and relevant external partners.

You might thrive in this role if you:
• Have experience leading complex, cross-functional work in a research, technology, policy, safety, security, governance, or related environment.

• Take initiative, move quickly, and find practical ways forward when ownership, requirements, or the path to an answer are unclear.

• Are intellectually curious and can learn unfamiliar subjects well enough to ask sharp questions, test an argument, and recognize when deeper expertise is needed.

• Can synthesize complicated or conflicting information without losing important distinctions, limitations, or uncertainty.

• Write clearly and precisely, particularly when explaining difficult issues and recommendations to senior decision-makers.

• Bring strong program-management fundamentals and a record of turning ambiguous requests into work that gets finished.

• Exercise sound judgment in sensitive situations, navigate disagreement constructively, and know when to act independently or seek a decision.

• Are willing to try new approaches, learn from feedback, and change your mind when the evidence changes.

• Build useful structure without adding unnecessary process.

• Care deeply about the responsible development and deployment of increasingly capable AI systems.

Helpful experience:
• Research program management or strategy and operations in a technically complex organization.

• AI safety, preparedness, model evaluations, cybersecurity, or technical risk management.

• Advisory committees, board-facing work, executive decision support, or other consequential reviews.

• Translating policies, standards, or governance decisions into practical requirements and programs.

• Strategic partnerships or sensitive deployment contexts.

About OpenAI
OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.
For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement .
Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link .

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase .

The Coinbase Developer Platform (CDP) is building crypto infrastructure at scale for any business, anywhere. As the Wallets PM, you will own the Flexible Custody roadmap serving fintechs, brokers, and corporates around their custody and DeFi needs.

What you'll do:

• Own the Unified Custody roadmap end to end

• Define the product strategy for custody model optionality, so customers choose self-custody, custodial, or hybrid per use case without rebuilding integrations.

• Partner with engineering, security, legal, and compliance to launch custody and DeFi products that meet the institutional bar for key management, controls, and regulatory posture.

• Translate customer and launch-partner needs into a prioritized roadmap tied to assets-on-platform and revenue targets.

• Measure and grow adoption: AOP and revenue, with clear funnel metrics from integration to funded accounts.

Required Skills and Experience:

• 5+ years of product management experience shipping developer-facing or API-first products, ideally custody, wallets, or fintech infrastructure.

• Deep understanding of crypto custody models (self-custody, MPC, qualified custodian) and DeFi primitives (lending, vaults, onchain yield).

• Track record of shipping 0-to-1 products with engineering teams and taking them to production scale with enterprise customers.

• Comfort operating in regulated environments; experience partnering with legal and compliance on licensing, asset segregation, and risk frameworks.

• Data-driven prioritization: you define success metrics up front and hold the team accountable to adoption and revenue outcomes.

• Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

About the role
We're looking for a Fullstack Engineer to join our Repository Services team in GitLab's Create stage. The team owns the repository side of Source Code: how code gets into a repository, who may change it, and how those changes are verified. We build this as an access layer on the primitives the Gitaly team provides, for GitLab's own features and for the artificial intelligence agents now writing and pushing code alongside people.
You'll work in one of GitLab's oldest and most complex product areas, using Ruby and GraphQL across GitLab.com , self-managed instances, and GitLab Dedicated. Repository Services is a new team, and its first months are about reliability and support, so you'll spend real time on performance and structured query language tuning, caching, rate limiting, testing, observability, and resiliency, with experienced team members to lean on. You'll collaborate with product management, product design, testing, security, user experience research, technical writing, Gitaly, Code Review, and the other Source Code teams.

What you'll do

• Develop secure, well-tested, performant features and improvements using Ruby and GraphQL.

• Work through complex requirements and legacy constraints to deliver clear solutions while protecting the reliability of this critical system.

• Design and maintain backend services, application programming interfaces, data models, and business logic that control how code reaches a repository, who may change it, and how it is verified.

• Build on the primitives Gitaly provides and work closely with the Gitaly team.

• Triage and fix bugs and support requests for the features the team owns.

• Collaborate across functions and teams, both asynchronously and synchronously, and involve domain experts when their input will improve the outcome.

• Use artificial intelligence agents for well-scoped work when they can speed up delivery without sacrificing quality, and critically review their output.

• Write maintainable code that follows GitLab's standards and contribute to constructive code reviews.

• Help strengthen reliability by monitoring production health metrics, participating in Tier 2 on-call, troubleshooting incidents, contributing to root cause analysis, and improving observability and resiliency.

• Share knowledge through code review, technical documentation, and everyday collaboration while learning from others.

• Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.

What you'll bring

• Professional experience building backend web applications, services, or application programming interfaces, with experience using Ruby and GraphQL.

• An understanding of relational databases, structured query language, data modeling, caching, background processing, and backend performance practices.

• Experience contributing to user-facing workflows and maintaining their underlying systems.

• Experience writing backend unit and integration tests, with familiarity with the testing pyramid, Git, and collaborative code review processes.

• Experience using artificial intelligence coding agents and reviewing their output, or an interest in building these skills in a complex monorepo.

• Clear written and spoken English communication skills, including sharing useful status updates in a remote, asynchronous environment.

• The ability to manage assigned priorities, work through ambiguity, take ownership of your work, and seek guidance when needed.

About the team
Repository Services is a small backend team in the Create stage, formed in September 2026 when Source Code split into focused teams. As the split is finalized we expect to own repository mirroring, Git Large File Storage (LFS), protected branches and Branch Rules, push rules, Code Owners (shared with Code Review), and commit and tag signing. We build on Gitaly's primitives and meet regularly with the Gitaly team, and our work serves GitLab.com , self-managed instances, and GitLab Dedicated.
The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity . Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

United States Salary Range
$115,200 — $194,400 USD

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

• Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being

• Flexible Paid Time Off

• Team Member Resource Groups

• Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan

• Growth and Development Fund

• Parental Leave

Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law . jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is The Role :

Billing powers Elastic's Cloud business. It runs across AWS, GCP, and Azure in over 50 regions. We oversee usage-based metering, consumption billing, and marketplace integrations at global scale.

The Billing Core team owns the data layer that makes billing correct, auditable, and automated. We work across two areas:

•
Usage — Collect and process usage and cost data. This data is the foundation of our billing and financial reporting.

•
Engine — Turn hourly usage data into customer invoices and revenue records.

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer I to drive technical direction within the Billing Core domain. This is a hands-on role. You will design systems, improve how we operate, and work across teams. You will help our billing services grow in scale, reliability, and developer productivity. You will work closely with Product, SRE, and Cloud Infrastructure teams.

What You Will Be Doing :

•
Own complex billing and account management systems that span multiple services and cloud providers.

•
Build large-scale data pipelines for billing data ingestion, transformation, and reconciliation.

•
Improve observability, incident response, and reliability of core billing systems using modern practices.

•
Shape system architecture for scale and modularity. Guide service design, API structure, and data modelling.

•
Work with SRE and Cloud teams to improve deployment, monitoring, and CI/CD pipelines.

•
Own Elasticsearch and PostgreSQL data architecture and performance. Focus on query speed, schema quality, and high availability.

•
Be the go-to technical reviewer for the billing core stack. Maintain technical consistency and quality standards.

•
Mentor engineers and tech leads across the Billing organization. Help raise the bar on design and operational standards.

•
Work with Product, Design, and Finance to set roadmap priorities. Make sure plans are feasible and aligned with business goals.

•
Take part in on-call rotations. Make sure systems are production-ready through automation, resilience testing, and alerting.

What You Bring :

•
8+ years in backend or platform engineering, with solid skills in Python and deep production experience with data storage and processing systems. You have a track record on schema and data modelling, performance, and high availability.

•
Experience with large-scale data processing and storage technologies, such as AWS Glue and Athena, Apache Spark, Iceberg, and Parquet.

•
Proven experience improving reliability, observability, and incident response in production systems.

•
Solid background in cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including networking, IAM, monitoring, and deployment.

•
Ability to lead multi-quarter projects across teams — building consensus and delivering results.

•
Track record of mentoring engineers, setting technical direction, and raising engineering standards.

•
Experience with SaaS billing, metering, or financial systems is a real plus.

•
Experience with PostgreSQL or Elasticsearch is a plus.

•
Clear written and verbal communication skills. Able to influence across teams and speak to both technical and non-technical partners.

•
Comfortable working on your own in a global, distributed, and async environment.

•
Able to work across projects, work across functions and teams, and adapt to changing team structures.

•
Track record of using AI to improve development practices, including design, development, and debugging, while continuing to own the outcomes.

•
Is eligible to work in Department of Defense (DoD) Impact Level 4 or above cloud service environments.

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number.
